title: Detailed heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='42%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9ec7'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#ff4f8b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c2205a'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='shine' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd6e6' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb0cc' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- main heart -->
  <path d='M50 88 C24 70 12 56 12 40 C12 27 22 18 34 18 C41 18 47 22 50 28 C53 22 59 18 66 18 C78 18 88 27 88 40 C88 56 76 70 50 88 Z' fill='url(#glow)' stroke='#ff7fae' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- inner highlight arc left lobe -->
  <path d='M30 32 C25 34 22 39 22 45 C22 50 25 55 30 60' fill='none' stroke='#ffc2d9' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- inner highlight arc right lobe -->
  <path d='M70 32 C75 34 78 39 78 45 C78 50 75 55 70 60' fill='none' stroke='#ffc2d9' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- big top-left gloss -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='33' rx='9' ry='6' fill='url(#shine)' transform='rotate(-28 33 33)'/>
  <!-- small gloss dot -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='28' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#ffe3ee' opacity='0.9' transform='rotate(-20 63 28)'/>
  <!-- center shimmer line -->
  <path d='M50 34 L50 78' stroke='#ffbcd6' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- little sparkles -->
  <path d='M82 22 l0 -8 M78 18 l8 0' stroke='#ffd6e6' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M16 66 l0 -6 M13 63 l6 0' stroke='#ffd6e6' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
